_comment: M17. One visit day, the same illustrative visit as report #04 on the homepage. Not a real patient. Times are India time, as minutes from midnight on the visit date; a negative number is the evening before. The waits are deliberate: they are what the family would otherwise take a day off for. 'msg' is what reaches the family's phone. Only messages the service already promises may appear here: the questions the family sends the night before, the short WhatsApp the desk composes before the companion leaves the building, and the report before midnight. Do not add a live update from the waiting room until that is a service we actually run. 'hl' marks the one line in the day that mattered, and there is only ever one.

events.title: You send the questions
events.text: Two things you want asked: the knee, and whether April's kidney result changes anything.

msg.text: Please ask about her right knee. And does the April kidney result matter for any painkiller?

events.title: The companion is at registration
events.text: With the file: four visits, every medicine she takes, and the April renal panel on paper.

events.title: Token 47, Orthopaedics room 12
events.text: The board shows 31. The wait starts, and nobody in the family has taken the morning off for it.

events.title: Still on the bench
events.text: An hour and a half in. The questions are written out and in the companion's hand.

events.title: Called in
events.text: The consultation starts. It will last eight minutes.

events.title: Oral diclofenac is proposed
events.text: The companion asks your second question and puts the April result on the desk.

events.title: The plan changes
events.text: The oral drug is withdrawn. A gel is prescribed instead, and a repeat kidney test is booked for 24 June.

events.title: Checked before leaving
events.text: The new prescription is read against every medicine she already takes, while the doctor is still down the corridor.

events.title: Leaving the building
events.text: The short version goes to you on WhatsApp before the companion is out of the hospital.

msg.text: Visit done. Oral painkiller not started: withdrawn because of the April kidney result. Gel twice daily instead. Kidney test booked 24 June. Full report tonight.

events.title: The report is written
events.text: Every question, what was said, what changed, and why, set against the three visits before it.

events.title: Report #04 is filed
events.text: In your inbox and your portal before midnight India time, as promised.

msg.text: Consultation report #04 is ready. 11 June, Orthopaedics.
